trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If I would have the money, I buy it.
trap.right: If I had the money, I would buy it.
trap.why: Avaliação: if + had + part./would have; misto; modais de conselho; object to + -ing. O brasileiro usa would após if.

mcq.q: If I had saved, I **___** bought a car.

fix.wrong: If I had saved, I will buy a car.
fix.right: If I had saved, I would have bought a car.
You ought to see the doctor.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I didn’t save, so I didn’t buy a car.”
rewrite.answer: If I had saved, I would have bought a car.
